g.text: Battery: JST-PH, power switch (JP2 bypasses it), divider 10M / 10M + 10nF into P0.31 (BlueMicro840 R4 R6 C6: 806k / 2M + 1nF)

g.desc: Battery: JST-PH, power switch (JP2 bypasses it), divider 10M / 10M + 10nF into P0.31 (BlueMicro840 R4 R6 C6: 806k / 2M + 1nF)

g.text: Charger MCP73831 (BlueMicro840 U4 is a TP4054, same pins): 100 mA, 200 mA with JP1 closed; white LED on while charging

g.desc: Charger MCP73831 (BlueMicro840 U4 is a TP4054, same pins): 100 mA, 200 mA with JP1 closed; white LED on while charging

g.desc: internal ADC (ADSEL low), mixer on (MSEL high); R120-R123 strap them (10k). Jack: tip L, ring 1 R, ring 2 GND, sleeve mic.

g.text: Open pins: internal pulls select headset mode (MODE low), 100 mA bus power (PWRSEL high),

g.desc: Open pins: internal pulls select headset mode (MODE low), 100 mA bus power (PWRSEL high),

g.text: Sound card CM108B (C-Media demo board v1.33 sheet 4, app notes v1.50); headset jack, CTIA

g.desc: Sound card CM108B (C-Media demo board v1.33 sheet 4, app notes v1.50); headset jack, CTIA

g.text: Power path: USB through the Schottky, battery through the P-MOSFET (off while VBUS is present)

g.desc: Power path: USB through the Schottky, battery through the P-MOSFET (off while VBUS is present)

g.text: 15. Reverse-battery P-MOSFET Q2 (SI2301) between the battery connector and the switch, gate to GND: a cell plugged in the wrong way round finds it off (its body diode blocks), so the charger's VBAT pin never sees a negative voltage; the right way round it is on (Vgs = -Vbat) and charging goes through it.

g.desc: 15. Reverse-battery P-MOSFET Q2 (SI2301) between the battery connector and the switch, gate to GND: a cell plugged in the wrong way round finds it off (its body diode blocks), so the charger's VBAT pin never sees a negative voltage; the right way round it is on (Vgs = -Vbat) and charging goes through it.

g.text: 17. VBUS: an SMF5.0A TVS at the receptacle, and C107 (4.7 uF) through 1 ohm: a ceramic-only VBUS rings on hot plug to 6-8 V through the cable's inductance (simulated, 0.5-1 uH); damped, 5.0-6.6 V, without adding capacitance.

g.desc: 17. VBUS: an SMF5.0A TVS at the receptacle, and C107 (4.7 uF) through 1 ohm: a ceramic-only VBUS rings on hot plug to 6-8 V through the cable's inductance (simulated, 0.5-1 uH); damped, 5.0-6.6 V, without adding capacitance.

g.text: 14. Built-in USB sound card: the USB-C data lines go (through the ESD array) to a CH334P hub; hub port 3 goes to the module's D+ / D-, port 2 to a CM108B codec (C-Media demo board v1.33) with a 3.5 mm headset jack.

g.desc: 14. Built-in USB sound card: the USB-C data lines go (through the ESD array) to a CH334P hub; hub port 3 goes to the module's D+ / D-, port 2 to a CM108B codec (C-Media demo board v1.33) with a 3.5 mm headset jack.

g.text: 13. Battery divider 10M + 10M with 10 nF (BlueMicro840: 806k + 2M, 1 nF): the MCP73831 recognises a missing battery only if VBAT sees more than 7 MOhm (datasheet 4.2); 10 nF >= 2^12 x the SAADC's 2.5 pF keeps the reading within 1 LSB (Nordic, 'Measuring Lithium battery voltage with nRF52'), and RMK samples it every 30 s. Drain 0.2 uA.

g.desc: 13. Battery divider 10M + 10M with 10 nF (BlueMicro840: 806k + 2M, 1 nF): the MCP73831 recognises a missing battery only if VBAT sees more than 7 MOhm (datasheet 4.2); 10 nF >= 2^12 x the SAADC's 2.5 pF keeps the reading within 1 LSB (Nordic, 'Measuring Lithium battery voltage with nRF52'), and RMK samples it every 30 s. Drain 0.2 uA.

g.text: 12. Charger MCP73831 instead of the TP4054, same pins and same PROG resistor (1000 V / R_PROG): it is stable with no battery, so the board also works when built without one (its STAT pin, and the white LED, stay off).

g.desc: 12. Charger MCP73831 instead of the TP4054, same pins and same PROG resistor (1000 V / R_PROG): it is stable with no battery, so the board also works when built without one (its STAT pin, and the white LED, stay off).

g.text: 11. C108 1 uF at the regulator output and C109 100 nF at the module: the 4.7 uF C103 sits at the module's supply pins (VDD / VDDH), 25 mm away (the module has about 12 uF inside: the TPS7A02 allows 1-22 uF on its output). C102 on VIN is 1 uF instead of 10 uF: together they keep the capacitance charged at USB attach near USB 2.0's 10 uF.

g.desc: 11. C108 1 uF at the regulator output and C109 100 nF at the module: the 4.7 uF C103 sits at the module's supply pins (VDD / VDDH), 25 mm away (the module has about 12 uF inside: the TPS7A02 allows 1-22 uF on its output). C102 on VIN is 1 uF instead of 10 uF: together they keep the capacitance charged at USB attach near USB 2.0's 10 uF.

g.text: USB-C (sink: 5.1k on each CC) and ESD protection

g.desc: USB-C (sink: 5.1k on each CC) and ESD protection

g.text: 16. Regulator TPS7A0233 (25 nA quiescent, 200 mA) instead of the AP2112K (55 uA): same SOT-23-5 pins (IN, GND, EN, NC, OUT); the 3.3 V rail needs < 50 mA (module, status LED).

g.desc: 16. Regulator TPS7A0233 (25 nA quiescent, 200 mA) instead of the AP2112K (55 uA): same SOT-23-5 pins (IN, GND, EN, NC, OUT); the 3.3 V rail needs < 50 mA (module, status LED).

g.text: 10. C107 4.7 uF added on VBUS at the charger's VDD pin (the MCP73831 datasheet asks for 4.7 uF; Nordic's reference circuit has 4.7 uF on VBUS; the BlueMicro840 has none).

g.desc: 10. C107 4.7 uF added on VBUS at the charger's VDD pin (the MCP73831 datasheet asks for 4.7 uF; Nordic's reference circuit has 4.7 uF on VBUS; the BlueMicro840 has none).
